articles.title: Y Combinator reveals a new AI agent that can build and run an entire business just from a text message
articles.snippet: Y Combinator's Locus Founder lets users text a business idea via iMessage, SMS, or Telegram, and the AI handles the rest.

articles.title: Profit-taking across bitcoin, ether, solana as traders wait on the Iran signing
articles.snippet: A U.S.-Iran deal pulled oil lower and lifted stocks, but bitcoin's bounce is hesitant. ETF outflows just paused after a record run, and analysts say the market wants the deal signed before pricing it in.

articles.title: SpaceX’s debut: A win for crypto price discovery, a fail for tokenized access
articles.snippet: SpaceX’s blockbuster debut didn’t just mint a trillionaire; it became a real-world stress test for crypto’s promise of democratized market access.
